extension.name: Matrx Extend
extension.proof: Chrome Extensions details page visibly showed name, exact ID, version, and Loaded from path.

method.surface: Native Google Chrome, actual unpacked development extension sidepanel Settings
actions: Closed the visibly failed Matrx OAuth window to reach the already-open Chrome Extensions details page for the exact development extension ID.
Recorded initial sidepanel Settings identity and error.
Clicked the extension's full Chrome Extensions Reload control, reopened the Matrx sidepanel and Settings, expanded Organization, and observed for 30 seconds.
Because admin identity returned, performed one additional full Chrome Extensions Reload, reopened Settings, and expanded Organization to verify persistence again.
method.constraints: No sign-in or sign-out, no storage/devtools/token inspection, no organization or settings changes, no other tabs touched. No screenshots retained because they could contain private data.

initial.error: Sign-in failed: The user did not approve access.
initial.oauth_window: Authorization error (400): Failed to load authorization details: Auth session missing!

after_first_full_reload.organization: ZZZ APPROVAL-TAIL throwaway a2c8a05f — safe to delete
after_first_full_reload.result: Identity and organization remained visible throughout the 30-second observation.

after_second_full_reload.organization: ZZZ APPROVAL-TAIL throwaway a2c8a05f — safe to delete
after_second_full_reload.result: Account, role, and organization were visible again after the second full reload.

limitations: Provisional native UI observation only; it does not establish whether stored tokens were deleted or explain the initial state.
The prior OAuth error window reported Auth session missing; this observation does not attribute it to the reload defect.
EXT-D-0007 remains open: source findings and independent verification are unresolved.
cleanup: Closed only the confidently identified failed Matrx OAuth error window. No settings or organization state changed.
